text: 据深圳特区报，近日，深圳市委副书记、市长李运会见中国邮政储蓄银行行长芦苇一行。李运表示，期待与邮储银行深化“六张网”、城市更新、产业园区等领域的务实合作，共同做好科技金融这篇大文章，携手实现互利共赢发展。芦苇表示，将充分发挥自身优势，聚焦服务实体经济，持续加大在深信贷投放，围绕基础设施建设、科技创新、新兴产业发展等领域加强对接合作，更好助力深圳高质量发展和现代化建设。
text_en: According to Shenzhen Special Zone Daily, Shenzhen Municipal Deputy Party Secretary and Mayor Li Yun recently met with Postal Savings Bank of China President Lu Wei and his delegation. Li Yun expressed hope to deepen practical cooperation with PSBC in areas such as the "six networks," urban renewal, and industrial parks, jointly advance the major initiative of science and technology finance, and work together to achieve mutually beneficial development. Lu Wei said PSBC will fully leverage its advantages, focus on serving the real economy, continue to increase credit lending in Shenzhen, strengthen coordination and cooperation in areas such as infrastructure construction, technological innovation, and emerging industry development, and better support Shenzhen's high-quality development and modernization.
